prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Photo-oxidation causes rapid degradation of polyunsaturated oils, with peroxide value increasing sixfold faster under UV-A radiation and degradation products including lutein endoperoxide and 5,6-epoxylutein.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06406","field":"abstract","quote":"Peroxide value increased sixfold faster under UV-A. Degradation products were tentatively identified by LC-MS as 5,6-epoxylutein and lutein endoperoxide."}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Light intensity is the dominant variable controlling shelf life of oily functional foods under retail conditions, exceeding the effect of temperature fluctuations, and has been quantitatively modelled using accelerated degradation kinetics.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-04277","field":"abstract","quote":"Sensitivity analysis identified light intensity as the dominant variable controlling shelf life under retail conditions, exceeding the effect of temperature fluctuations typical of Serbian supermarket cold chains."}]}]}
